label: DEEP-RESEARCH TASK: DATA / PRODUCTIVITY / UTILITY app feasibility in 2026. For EACH of: G

apps.name: Google Slides
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS, no API needed. File > Share > Publish to web > Embed gives a public iframe (docs.google.com/presentation/d/e/.../embed). Add ?start=true&loop=true&delayms=N for auto-advance, and rm=minimal for kiosk mode (no controls, no Google branding). Deck must be Published-to-web (public). Auto-refreshes when the source deck changes (a few-min cache). Pure iframe, no key.
apps.notes: Best-in-class productivity app to ship first. Config form = paste the share/publish URL, we transform it to the /embed?rm=minimal&start=true&loop=true&delayms= form and set the WEBPAGE src. Detect the URL pattern and auto-append kiosk params so the operator never edits query strings.

apps.name: PowerPoint / OneDrive
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS as of 2026. In PowerPoint for the web: File > Share > Embed this Presentation -> iframe (onedrive.live.com/embed or view.officeapps.live.com). File must live on OneDrive and be shared publicly (anonymous view). Auto-reflects edits. NOTE: Office Online Server (on-prem) retires 31-Dec-2026 but that does NOT affect the cloud OneDrive/Office.com embed. iframe is the officially documented method; no API/token for the public-embed path.
apps.notes: Symmetric with Google Slides. Config = paste OneDrive/Office embed URL. Sign-in-required files won't render on a headless kiosk, so the config form must warn 'file must be shared publicly' and validate. A deeper Microsoft 365 Graph integration (pick a file from SharePoint/OneDrive via OAuth) is the L-effort upgrade OptiSigns/Comeen/Valotalive built.

apps.name: Canva
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS via public embed link. In Canva: Share > More > Embed -> HTML/iframe (canva.com/design/.../view?embed). Design must be set to public/'anyone with the link'. Live-updates when the design changes. This is the exact method OptiSigns documents. Alternative: download PNG/PDF and upload as an asset (no live update). Canva Connect OAuth API exists (we have CANVA_CLIENT_ID/SECRET envs) but the picker is not built.
apps.notes: Ship the paste-embed-link path now (S). We already stubbed Canva Connect OAuth for Sprint 11 design-imports; the named 'Canva' app in the library can be the paste-link version, with an upsell to full Connect import later. Config = paste Canva embed URL.

apps.name: Google Calendar
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS two ways. (1) Public iframe: calendar.google.com/calendar/embed?src=<calId> — Settings > 'Integrate calendar' gives the iframe; calendar must be public. Renders Google's own month/agenda UI. (2) ICS feed: the public/secret .ics URL parsed by OUR CALENDAR widget for a branded render. iframe = zero effort; ICS = branded but needs a parser + cron poll.
apps.notes: Two tiers: S = paste public embed URL into WEBPAGE (Google's UI, ugly but instant). M = paste ICS feed URL, poll server-side (~15min), render in our branded CALENDAR widget. The branded ICS path is the differentiator vs OptiSigns.

apps.name: Outlook / Microsoft 365 Calendar
apps.howEmbedded2026: PARTIAL. Outlook has no official website-embed button, but Outlook-on-web > Settings > Calendar > Shared calendars > Publish gives BOTH an HTML link (loads a full published-calendar page you can iframe) AND an ICS feed URL. Best path = consume the published ICS in our CALENDAR widget. Microsoft Graph API (OAuth) is the clean enterprise route but heavy.
apps.notes: ICS-feed path shares the exact same parser as Google Calendar/iCal — build one ICS ingest, get Google + Outlook + Apple + any iCal source for free. This is the smart consolidation.

apps.name: iCal / ICS feed (generic)
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS. Any public .ics URL (Apple iCloud shared calendar, church/school calendars, Eventbrite, Teamup, etc.). Server-side fetch + parse (ical.js / node-ical) + render in CALENDAR widget. No key, no ToS issue — ICS is an open standard (RFC 5545).
apps.notes: The universal calendar primitive. Build ONE server-side ICS ingest + poll + normalize, expose it as the backend for the Google/Outlook/Apple/generic calendar apps. One M-effort backend, four named apps in the library.

apps.name: Google Sheets
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS. File > Share > Publish to web > Embed -> iframe (docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/.../pubhtml). Can scope to a single sheet/range via gid + range params. ~5-min cache, not real-time. Also can pull as CSV/JSON (gviz) for a branded render. Public-publish required.
apps.notes: Two tiers: S = paste publish-to-web URL into WEBPAGE (Google's grid). M = pull the CSV/gviz JSON and render in our LIVE_DATA/CHART widget for a branded table/chart. The branded path pairs perfectly with our CHART widget for KPI boards.

apps.name: Google Docs
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS. File > Share > Publish to web > Embed -> iframe (docs.google.com/document/d/e/.../pub). Renders the doc as a scrolling page. Public-publish required. Lower signage value than Slides/Sheets (docs are long-form, not glanceable) but trivial to support.
apps.notes: Low priority — long-form text is poor signage. Ship it only for completeness alongside Slides/Sheets since it's the same paste-URL pattern. OptiSigns doesn't even bother listing it.

apps.name: News (RSS / Google News)
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS FREE via RSS. Google News RSS (news.google.com/rss + topic/search params) and any publisher RSS are free/keyless — parse server-side, render in our RSS_FEED widget. Google News RSS is fine for signage volume but 'not for production-scale pipelines.' We already have RSS_FEED.
apps.notes: We already ship RSS_FEED. The 'News' app = a curated RSS_FEED with preset feed URLs (Google News topics: Top/World/Business/Tech/Sports/local-by-query, plus BBC/AP/Reuters/NPR). Operator picks a topic, we fill the URL. Zero new backend.

apps.name: News (NewsAPI / GNews / NewsData.io)
apps.howEmbedded2026: API path. NewsAPI free tier is DEV-ONLY (no production). GNews / Currents / NewsData.io / Mediastack / Guardian offer usable free tiers with limits + require a key. Gives cleaner structured headlines + images than raw RSS but adds key management + rate-limit handling.
apps.notes: Skip unless a customer needs richer/curated headlines. RSS covers 90% of signage news needs free. If built, use GNews or NewsData.io (production-legal free tier), platform key server-side, cache aggressively to stay under limits.

apps.name: Weather (enrichment)
apps.howEmbedded2026: ALREADY SHIPPED. Our WEATHER widget exists. Enrichment in 2026: add NWS/NOAA (api.weather.gov, free, keyless, US) for alerts + forecast; add hourly/7-day, radar tile, 'feels-like', air-quality. NWS CAP alerts (see Public-alert row) can drive a weather-warning banner.
apps.notes: Not a new app — enrich the existing WEATHER widget: 7-day + hourly variants, NWS radar tile, and an auto weather-alert banner sourced from api.weather.gov (free, US-authoritative). This ties into our emergency/weather-alert moat.

apps.name: Countdown / Clock / Date
apps.howEmbedded2026: ALREADY SHIPPED, no external anything. We have CLOCK, COUNTDOWN widgets. 100% client-side (device time / target date). Timezone + 12/24h + format are config fields. Zero API, zero ToS.
apps.notes: Already covered by CLOCK + COUNTDOWN. In the Apps library these become named tiles ('Countdown', 'World Clock', 'Digital Clock', 'Date') that drop the existing widget with a polished config. No backend. Keep client-side (Taurus-safe: avoid modern-only Intl edge cases, test on Chromium-83).

apps.name: QR Code
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS, self-hosted, no third party needed. Generate QR SVG/PNG in-house (qrcode npm lib, server or client). Never depend on an external QR image API (privacy + offline). Renders as an IMAGE/inline SVG. Zero ToS, works offline on Taurus.
apps.notes: Tiny new widget: input a URL/text -> render QR as inline SVG (Taurus-safe, offline-cacheable). Do NOT use api.qrserver.com or Google Charts (deprecated) — bundle the generator. Great signage utility (menu links, wifi, event signup).

apps.name: Web Page / URL
apps.howEmbedded2026: ALREADY SHIPPED. Our WEBPAGE widget is a null-origin sandboxed iframe of any URL. This is the fallback for any site that offers an embed/public URL. Caveats: X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors CSP blocks many sites; some need allow-same-origin (security tradeoff).
apps.notes: The universal escape hatch. Every paste-a-URL app above rides this. Keep it as the 'Website' tile AND the engine under named apps. ToS-medium because embedding arbitrary sites can violate their terms / break on CSP; the named-app configs de-risk the common cases.

apps.name: PDF
apps.howEmbedded2026: ALREADY SHIPPED (asset). PDFs upload as Assets and render; we've done extensive work stripping the Chrome PDF-viewer toolbar (hover-only mount) and generating first-page previews. For signage, single-page or auto-advancing pages. No external API. Public PDF URLs can also be iframed but the asset path is better (offline cache).
apps.notes: Already handled via the asset pipeline (upload -> preview -> playlist). In the Apps library, 'PDF' = upload-or-pick-a-PDF with page-advance config. Reuse the existing toolbar-strip + first-page-preview work. Note: rasterizing pages to images is the most Taurus-safe render.

apps.name: Stocks / Markets
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS. Fastest: TradingView free embeddable widgets (ticker tape, single quote, mini-chart, market overview) — one-line script/iframe, no key, their branding. Or API path: Finnhub / Alpha Vantage / Twelve Data (free tiers, key) for a branded ticker in LIVE_DATA. TradingView widget = S; branded API ticker = M.
apps.notes: Ship TradingView widget first (S, reuses WEBPAGE/EXTERNAL_HTML with their script). ToS-medium: TradingView widgets require attribution and are for their widget terms; some market-data licenses restrict public display. For a branded ticker, Finnhub free tier + server cache.

apps.name: Crypto
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS, easiest of all finance. CoinGecko free API (keyless-ish, generous), CoinMarketCap/Coinlib/LiveCoinWatch/Crypto.com free embeddable ticker widgets (one-line, no key). Branded path: poll CoinGecko server-side -> LIVE_DATA ticker. Crypto free tiers are far more generous than stock market data.
apps.notes: Two tiers: S = drop a CoinGecko/CoinMarketCap embed widget in WEBPAGE. M = poll CoinGecko free API server-side, render branded scrolling ticker in LIVE_DATA (matches our brand). Crypto data has no real display-license issue unlike equities.

apps.name: Traffic / Transit
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS but agency-specific. Transit = GTFS-Realtime (open spec: trip updates, vehicle positions, service alerts) — each agency publishes its own feed (often free, sometimes key). Parse protobuf server-side -> branded departure board. Traffic = Google Maps Embed API traffic layer (iframe) or a Maps traffic screenshot. No single national feed; per-agency config.
apps.notes: L because GTFS-RT is protobuf + per-agency onboarding (feed URL, sometimes API key, agency ToS). High value for transit hubs/campuses but niche. Defer unless a transit/campus customer asks. Traffic-map layer via Google Maps Embed is the S fallback.

apps.name: Flights
apps.howEmbedded2026: API only, PAID. FlightAware AeroAPI (real-time status/tracking, paid, generous but not free), AviationStack/FlightStats (freemium). No free public flight feed. Build a branded arrivals/departures board from the API. Screenfeed sells a ready-made flight-board signage app (aggregator dependency).
apps.notes: Niche (airports, hotels near airports, corporate lobbies). L + paid API. Defer to a customer-driven build. If needed, AeroAPI server-side + branded LIVE_DATA board; pass API cost through as a managed line item.

apps.name: Sports Scores
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS. ESPN's undocumented/hidden JSON endpoints (site.api.espn.com .../scoreboard) are keyless + free + cover NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/college — poll server-side, render branded. TheSportsDB free API (JSON, key 'test'/free tier) for broader leagues + logos. Paid: Sportradar/API-Sports for licensed real-time. We ALREADY have a whole Sports vertical (scoreboards, ScoreSource) to plug this into.
apps.notes: Strong fit — we already have Sprint-13 sports infra + ScoreSource. A 'Live Scores' app = poll ESPN/TheSportsDB server-side into a branded scores widget. ToS-medium: ESPN endpoints are unofficial (could change/rate-limit); TheSportsDB is sanctioned for the free tier. Cache + graceful fallback.

apps.name: Currency / Exchange
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS, fully free. Frankfurter (frankfurter.dev — ECB rates, NO key, open source, 30+ currencies) or ExchangeRate-API free tier (1500 req, no card). Poll server-side, render branded FX board/converter in LIVE_DATA. Zero ToS friction with Frankfurter.
apps.notes: Easy win for hotels/airports/international lobbies. Frankfurter needs no signup or key — server-side poll (daily rates), render a branded rate table in LIVE_DATA. Genuinely S-effort, low risk.

apps.name: Public Alert / CAP (weather + emergency)
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS FREE, US. NWS/NOAA api.weather.gov exposes active alerts as JSON + CAP v1.2 XML + ATOM (by state/county/zone), keyless. This is the FEMA IPAWS-profile feed. Poll by county/zone -> render a weather/emergency banner. This is directly adjacent to our emergency moat (weather-alert templates already exist).
apps.notes: HIGH strategic value — this feeds our life-safety story. A 'Weather/Public Alerts' app that auto-polls api.weather.gov for the tenant's county and drives an auto weather-alert banner (and could pre-arm the emergency system). Keyless + free + authoritative. Full IPAWS inbound is on our V2 roadmap (Standard Audit Surface #13).

apps.name: Power BI
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS. Power BI Service > Publish to web (public) -> iframe embed code (managed under 'Manage embed codes'). PUBLIC data only — 'Publish to web' is anonymous/anyone-on-internet, so orgs often disable it for governance. Secure embed needs Power BI Embedded (Azure AD/service principal, L-effort). OptiSigns ships Power BI.
apps.notes: Ship the 'Publish to web' iframe path (S). ToS-medium: many enterprises BLOCK publish-to-web for security, so the config must explain the requirement. The secure/authenticated Power BI Embedded path is L and needs Azure app registration — defer to enterprise ask.

apps.name: Looker Studio / Data Studio
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS, cleaner than Power BI. Looker Studio: set report to 'Public'/'anyone with link', File > Embed report > Enable embedding -> auto-generated iframe. No key. Great for GA/marketing/ops dashboards. (Legacy 'Data Studio' = same product renamed.)
apps.notes: Easier + lower-risk than Power BI (Google's public-embed is first-class). Config = paste the Looker Studio embed URL into WEBPAGE. Good default BI app to feature.

apps.name: Tableau
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS. Tableau Public / Tableau Cloud (Public visibility) -> Share/Embed -> iframe or JS Embedding API v3. Public workbooks embed keyless; Tableau Cloud private needs Connected Apps/JWT (L). OptiSigns ships Tableau.
apps.notes: Ship Tableau Public embed path (S). Private Tableau Cloud = JWT/Connected Apps (L, enterprise). ToS-medium for the same publish-to-public governance reason as Power BI.

apps.name: Google Maps
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS, free. Maps Embed API is free with unlimited usage (needs a GCP API key with billing enabled but $0 for Embed). Modes: place, view, directions, streetview, search. Also a legacy keyless endpoint (maps.google.com/maps?...&output=embed) stable since 2014. We ALREADY have GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY (used for geocoding).
apps.notes: Easy — we already have the key + a server-side geocode proxy. 'Map' app: operator types an address/place, we build the Maps Embed iframe (place/directions/traffic mode). Restrict key to Embed+referrer. Great for wayfinding/lobby/'find us' signage.

apps.name: Spotify (now-playing / playlist)
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS as a PLAYER, not passive signage. Spotify Embed = iframe of a track/album/playlist (open.spotify.com/embed/...) with iFrame API (play/pause/change) — but audio needs user gesture + auth for full tracks (30s preview otherwise), so it's interactive, not fire-and-forget signage. True 'now playing' = Web API currently-playing endpoint (OAuth per user). We have MUSIC_PLAYER.
apps.notes: Signage caveat: embeds don't autoplay full tracks headless (browser autoplay policy + Spotify auth). Best fit = a 'now-playing' visual card (album art + track) via Web API OAuth, OR the embed for an interactive kiosk. Set expectations: it's a display/interactive widget, not a background-music engine. ToS-medium (Spotify branding + auth rules).

apps.name: Apple Music
apps.howEmbedded2026: WORKS similarly to Spotify. Apple Music embeddable web player (embed.music.apple.com) now lets signed-in users play full songs (2026 update); anonymous = 30-90s previews. MusicKit JS for deeper control (Apple Developer token). Same headless-autoplay caveat as Spotify.
apps.notes: Same story as Spotify — interactive/now-playing display, not autoplay background audio on a headless screen. Lower priority than Spotify. Pair both under a 'Now Playing' app that shows art + metadata.

apps.name: Menu / POS (dynamic menu board)
apps.howEmbedded2026: ALREADY SHIPPED + a strategic strength. We have ~30 menu boards (signage/{qsr,menus-pos,bar}) with live applyMenu() (per-location POS price + auto-86), a POS connector registry, and a menu-management platform in flight. Square/Toast/Clover/Lightspeed pull menu+price+availability via their APIs (OAuth). This is our build, not an iframe.
apps.notes: Our differentiator — don't reduce to an iframe. In the Apps library, 'Menu Board' = pick a menu template + connect a POS (Square/Toast/Clover) via the existing connector registry -> live price/86 push. Effort M only because plumbing exists; per-connector OAuth is the remaining L work per provider.

apps.name: Digital Menu (static/manual)
apps.howEmbedded2026: ALREADY SHIPPED. The same menu boards without a POS connection — operator edits items/prices by hand via our click-to-edit shim. No external dependency, fully offline-safe on Taurus.
apps.notes: The no-POS entry point to menu boards. Reuses the EXTERNAL_HTML menu templates + click-to-edit. Ship as the default 'Menu' app; 'connect POS for live prices' is the upsell to the dynamic version above.

uxNotes: OptiSigns' apps marketplace is a filterable grid of named app tiles (icon + name) grouped by category (Social Media, News, Finance, Business, Photos & Video, File Management, Communication, Misc, Weather) with ~10 pages of apps and pagination. Each tile opens a per-app config screen rather than a raw URL box — this is exactly the model VenueOS should copy for the Apps library inside the template editor.

The winning pattern across OptiSigns/Yodeck/ScreenCloud/Rise Vision: the operator NEVER sees a query string. They paste a share/publish link (Slides, Sheets, Canva, Power BI, Looker) and the app config transforms it into the correct kiosk-mode embed URL (e.g. appending rm=minimal&start=true&loop=true&delayms= for Google Slides, or scoping a Sheet to a range).

Named apps beat a generic 'Website' box because each can (a) validate the URL is the right shape, (b) warn about the #1 failure mode up front ('this file must be Published to web / shared publicly or the screen will show a login wall'), and (c) inject signage-specific params the operator would never know to add.

Most productivity/BI/calendar apps in 2026 still resolve to a public iframe under the hood — the value the app adds is the guided config + validation + branding, not a new transport. This means the bulk of the library can ride our existing WEBPAGE widget with a thin per-app config form (S effort).

Two-tier design pays off: an S-tier 'paste the embed link' version (Google's/Microsoft's own UI in an iframe) shipped first, then an M-tier 'branded render' version that pulls the underlying feed (ICS, CSV, JSON, RSS) into our own widget so it matches the tenant's brand. Calendars, Sheets, news, stocks, crypto, currency, and scores all have this branded upgrade path.

Consolidate the backend, not just the UI: one server-side ICS ingest powers Google Calendar + Outlook + Apple + generic iCal as four separate library tiles; one poll-and-cache service can back stocks/crypto/currency/scores. Build the primitive once, expose many named apps.

Config forms should default to auto-detect + sensible signage defaults (auto-advance on, controls off, kiosk mode, brand palette applied) so the operator's happy path is: pick app -> paste link (or pick a preset topic) -> done, in under 30 seconds — matching the VenueOS 30-second UX gate.

Social apps (Instagram/Facebook/X/TikTok) are the exception where 2026 reality forces an aggregator (EmbedSocial/Curator/Walls.io/Juicer) because the platforms killed direct public embeds — so those app tiles must honestly surface 'needs a connected account/aggregator,' unlike the productivity/data apps which mostly just need a public link.
doBetterIdeas: Auto-transform pasted links: when an operator pastes ANY Google/Microsoft/Canva/BI share URL, detect the provider by regex and rewrite it into the correct kiosk embed form automatically (append rm=minimal/start/loop for Slides, scope Sheets to a range, enable Looker embedding hints) — OptiSigns makes users hunt for the embed code; we can accept the normal share link.

Route the whole Apps library through our AI Integration Concierge: operator describes what they want ('show our lunch menu that updates from Toast' or 'our company OKR dashboard from Looker') and the Concierge picks the right app, pre-fills the config, and validates the link is public — turning a marketplace into a one-sentence request.

Ship a BRANDED render tier for every data/calendar/news app (ICS->our CALENDAR, CSV/gviz->our CHART, RSS/CAP->our RSS_FEED ticker, Frankfurter->our LIVE_DATA) so dashboards match the tenant's palette and fonts instead of showing Google's/Microsoft's raw chrome — a superintendent-grade look OptiSigns' iframe tiles can't match.

Pre-flight validation with a live thumbnail: before saving, headlessly fetch the target and detect the two killers — X-Frame-Options/CSP frame-ancestors block and a login/permission wall — then show a green 'will display' or a specific fix ('set this Google Slides deck to Publish to web'). This kills the #1 signage support ticket.

Offline-safe by design for Taurus: for QR (bundle the generator, never call an external QR image API), PDF (rasterize pages), and any polled data (cache last-good in the service worker), degrade gracefully on the Chromium-83 LED controllers where heavy SDKs and modern-only APIs break — a reliability edge over web-only competitors.

Lean into the life-safety moat: a 'Weather & Public Alerts' app auto-wired to api.weather.gov (free, keyless, US-authoritative, IPAWS-profile CAP) for the tenant's county that can both display a routine forecast AND auto-raise a weather-warning banner — no competitor pairs an everyday app with native emergency alerting on the same screen.

Own the menu/POS category instead of iframing it: our live applyMenu() (per-location price + auto-86) + POS connector registry already beats a Canva-menu-in-an-iframe; present 'Menu Board' as a first-class app with 'connect your POS for live prices' rather than a static image, which is the OptiSigns/Canva ceiling.
Consolidate calendars behind one ICS engine and market four named tiles (Google/Outlook/Apple/iCal) from a single M-effort backend — customers see breadth, we maintain one parser + one poll job.
findings.summary: The great news: in 2026 the vast majority of data/productivity/utility apps still resolve to a public iframe or a free/keyless feed, so most can ride VenueOS's existing WEBPAGE, CALENDAR, RSS_FEED, LIVE_DATA, CHART, WEATHER, CLOCK, and MUSIC_PLAYER widgets with only a thin per-app config form (S effort). Google Slides, PowerPoint/OneDrive, Canva, Google Sheets/Docs, Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, Google Maps, and Google Calendar all embed via a public 'publish/share -> iframe' flow that requires only that the source be shared publicly — the app's real value is guided config, URL auto-transform (kiosk params), and up-front warnings about the login-wall/CSP failure modes, not a new transport. Genuinely free keyless feeds exist for the branded tier: NWS/NOAA (api.weather.gov, CAP alerts + weather), Frankfurter (currency), CoinGecko (crypto), Google News/publisher RSS (news), and ESPN's hidden JSON + TheSportsDB (sports scores). A handful need real API+key work (NewsAPI-class news M, transit GTFS-RT L, flights AeroAPI paid/L, Spotify/Apple Music OAuth M with a headless-autoplay caveat, secure Power BI/Tableau Embedded L). QR should be self-hosted (bundle the generator, offline-safe on Taurus); Countdown/Clock/PDF/Menu are already built. Strategic wins to lead with: the api.weather.gov 'Public Alerts' app (feeds our life-safety moat), the ICS-consolidation play (one backend -> Google/Outlook/Apple/iCal tiles), branded render tiers that match tenant brand, and treating Menu/POS as a first-class owned app rather than an iframe. OptiSigns ships only ~a dozen of these (Canva, Slides, Power BI, Tableau, RSS, Weather, YouTube, social) — VenueOS can credibly exceed their library breadth quickly because we already own the widgets and a Concierge to auto-wire them.
